'''Turret Operator''' is a weak {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} encounter found in {{2|Glory}}, featuring a Living Shield and a Turret Operator.

== Turret Operator ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Turret Operator
|Image  = StS2_Turret Operator.png
|HP     = 41
|AscHP  = 51
|Debut  = Glory
|Type   = Normal
}}
=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Turret Operator}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Unload!
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (3;{{Asc2|9|4}}) damage x5.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Loading
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 1 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Follows a fixed 3-move cycle:
# {{Int2|Turret Operator|Unload!}}
# {{Int2|Turret Operator|Unload!}}
# {{Int2|Turret Operator|Loading}}

{{Clear}}

{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Shield Slam
|Intent = Attack1
|Effect = Deals 6 damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Smash
|Intent = Attack3, Buff
|Effect = Deals (16;{{Asc2|9|18}}) damage. Gains 3 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
* Uses {{Int2|Living Shield|Shield Slam}} every turn while the '''Turret Operator''' is alive.
** Once the '''Turret Operator''' is killed, switches to {{Int2|Living Shield|Smash}} every turn.

{{Clear}}

== Useful Cards ==
* The '''Turret Operator''''s damage is split into multiple hits with low damage on each, so {{BD2|Strength}} reduction from cards like {{C2|Piercing Wail}}, {{C2|Shared Fate}} or {{C2|Mangle}} will decrease his damage significantly and will often set it to 0.
* The '''Turret Operator''' will take five times as much damage as most enemies from {{BD2|Thorns}}.

== Trivia ==
* '''Turret Operator and Living Shield''' appear to be designed in reference to Slay the Spire 1's {{M|Centurion}} and {{M|Mystic}}. The two fights' combatants share similar proportions, and both '''Living Shield''' and Centurion employ an additional attack if their smaller companion is killed.
